input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale:
PERIOD (the flagged check): Section 19.2 sets the Deliverable conformance period at "ninety days" — ninety days equals 90 days, i.e. three months — running from the later of delivery or acceptance, and sets the hosted Services conformance period as the full subscription term, which under Section 8.1 runs to three years. Both periods are >= 90 days and the hosted-software period is expressed in years, so the rule's period requirement is satisfied on the face of the document. The deterministic check fails only because the drafters spelled the numeral out ("ninety days") instead of writing "90 days"; the verifier has twice confirmed this as a false negative. We do not redline a conforming clause to satisfy a pattern match. If the reviewing team wants the numeral to read mechanically, the wholly non-substantive fix is to render it "ninety (90) days" — recorded here as an optional housekeeping note, deliberately not raised with Silverline as a negotiation item.

REMEDY: Section 19.4 (p0079) gives the full preferred ladder for breach of 19.1 or 19.2 — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement of the nonconforming item at no charge, then, if Vendor cannot cure within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it — and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.

SCOPE: Section 19.1 (p0076) warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards plus material conformity to documentation and specifications. Section 19.3 warrants no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no mid-term functionality degradation and no open-source contamination of Customer source code. Section 19.5 (p0080) is a mutual implied-warranty disclaimer that expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the conformance warranty and there is no "AS IS" walk-away exposure. Sections 6.1-6.2 add a parallel acceptance correction-and-refund path. Every material term meets or exceeds the playbook position, so the finding is compliant with no redline and no counterparty comment.
